steps: Build the pinned source on the owner Mac and run both test suites.
Install alpha.22 after quitting the previous Pocket i process.
Repeat the DeBERTa question that produced the alpha.21 transport timeout.
Require the private log to pass grounding_signals instead of timing out.
Inspect the final answer and every subsequent stage before running the remaining fixed questions.
privacy: The build protocol is public. Owner questions, retrieved conversations and per-question logs remain private.
success: The same physical query completes the local grounding call and produces either a supported answer or a later explicit fail-closed decision.
failure: Any local transport timeout, missing grounding stage, unlogged stop, unsupported answer or private-data publication fails the checkpoint.
